values.note: Peak season $29 single / $58 double; non-peak (2026: Sept 20 - Nov 14, first-come) $17.25 / $34.50. 'Fees are reduced when the water system is off.' One vehicle included, $8 per extra vehicle per night. Same rates in 2027.

season.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232369/rates (a First-come, First-served Season runs 2026-09-20 to 2026-11-14 at non-peak fees after the reservable season ends 09-19) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/camp-dick-campground (Non-Peak Season fees), read 2026-10-26: the derived 09-19 close is the end of the reservable season, moved to booking.season; no page states when the campground itself closes

values.note: 41 sites for tents, campers, trailers and RVs (20 reservable, 21 first-come; nine are double sites). The reservable sites take vehicles of 30-45 ft, all back-in; the first-come sites have no lengths listed. RVs must fit on the parking spur.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/camp-dick-campground ('There are 41 sites that will accommodate tents, campers, trailers, and RVs'; 'Campsites 1-6, 11, 13-20, 24, 26, 28 and 39-41 are first come, first served. Campsites 7-10, 12, 21-23, 25, 27, and 29-38 are reservable.') + campsite catalog for 232369 (20 reservable STANDARD NONELECTRIC sites, Max Vehicle Length 30-45, Back-In; first-come sites catalogued as MANAGEMENT with no attributes, and the 99-ft 'XXX' record is a management placeholder) + /campgrounds/232369 ('RVs, trailers or other vehicles must fit on the parking spur'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Water spigots; nearest showers 12 miles north at Meeker Park Lodge. Firewood sold in peak season.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/camp-dick-campground ('Picnic tables, fire grates, water, vault toilets, and trash services are provided. There is no electricity, hook-ups, dump stations or showers.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232369 ('Water spigots, vault toilets ... the nearest showers are 12 miles north, at Meeker Park Lodge'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Sites 7-10, 12, 21-23, 25, 27 and 29-38 are reservable, the other 21 first-come. FS: reservations 'between Memorial Day and Labor Day weekends'; recreation.gov's 2026 reservable season is May 15 - Sept 19, first-come after that to Nov 14. Booking closes 4 days before arrival. 2-night weekend and 3-night holiday-weekend minimums (not marked soft). 14 nights in any 60. A reserved site not occupied within 26 hours goes first-come. 'The campground is normally full for the weekend before Friday morning.'

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/camp-dick-campground (Reservations and General Information, quoted) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232369 (facility_rules minWeekendStay 2 'Ignore Holidays', minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxStay 14 'Rolling 60 Days', reservationCutOff 4 'day(s) prior to arrival'; notice 'All campsites must be occupied within 26 hours') + /rates (2026 Peak 05-15 to 09-19, First-come 09-20 to 11-14), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Senior, Access, Golden Age and Golden Access passes: 50% off, single campsites only.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/camp-dick-campground ('Interagency Senior, Interagency Access, Golden Age and Golden Access passes provide cardholders a 50% discount on campground fees (this discount only applies to single campsites)'), read 2026-10-26

note: Site of a 1930s CCC camp in a glacial valley on Middle Saint Vrain Creek, a mile off the Peak to Peak Highway (CO-72) by Peaceful Valley (Boulder RD, Arapaho-Roosevelt NF), 8,650 ft; forest and open meadow, trails toward the Indian Peaks Wilderness. Bear lockers at sites with tent pads. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $17.25-29 (2026-27), no hookups, reservable on recreation.gov. Changed count 20 -> 41 (FS: 41 sites, 20 reservable + 21 FCFS) and max_rig_ft 99 -> 45 (the 99 was a management placeholder; reservable sites 30-45 ft). Cleared the derived season close 09-19 (end of the reservable season; first-come runs to Nov 14) and recorded it as booking.season 05-15 to 09-19. Added some_sites FCFS, 4-day cutoff, 2/3-night weekend/holiday minimums, 14 per 60 days, vault toilets, spigot water, no dump/showers, senior/access 50%. No alert affects CR 92/CO-72.
